_meta.description: Event table, owned by Member 2. This starter set covers each category (hazard, discovery, crew, equipment) - expand to ~15-20 total following the same schema, then hand off to Member 1 to wire into the trigger system on Day 12 (Oct 7).

events.trigger_condition: random_chance: 8% per sol after sol 3 and rover_or_eva_activity
events.text: Lunar dust has accumulated on the solar arrays, reducing the light reaching their cells until the arrays are cleaned or the effect expires.
Sensors detect an incoming solar particle event. Crew must shelter immediately.

choices.text: Push through to finish current task

events.text: The rover detects a hydrogen-rich volatile prospect. It may contain water ice, but the signal must be investigated before the outpost can plan extraction.

choices.text: Mark the prospect and continue the mission

events.trigger_condition: random_chance: 6% per sol if structure_age > 10 sols
events.text: A key system is malfunctioning and running below capacity until repaired.

choices.text: Divert crew time to repair immediately
Let it run at reduced capacity

events.text: Tensions rise under the pressure of outpost life.
An unexpectedly strong crop cycle boosts food output for a while.
A micrometeorite strikes the outpost, damaging a structure.
A scheduled resupply delivery arrives, adding to your materials stockpile.
